region_or_platform_notes: The changelog says this name is discontinued on 2026-07-24 and, until then, points to the thinking mode of deepseek-v4-flash. The V4 preview note says these names are fully retired and inaccessible after Jul 24th, 2026, 15:59 (UTC Time). Replacement named on that sentence: deepseek-v4-flash.

sources.label: DeepSeek V4 preview note
sources.excerpt: deepseek-chat & deepseek-reasoner will be fully retired and inaccessible after Jul 24th, 2026, 15:59 (UTC Time).

sources.label: DeepSeek API changelog
sources.excerpt: The two legacy API model names, deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner, will be discontinued in three months (2026-07-24). | During the current period, these two model names point to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode of deepseek-v4-flash, respectively.
